## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` and `pnpm build` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for changed behavior
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, or customer data committed
- [ ] Accessibility checked (keyboard, focus, alt text, reduced motion) for UI changes
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/`, `.env.example`) if setup or behavior changed

<!-- Delete any that don't apply: -->

- [ ] Security-sensitive change (CSP, headers, booking API, env, CI): see SECURITY.md
- [ ] Legal copy changed: `legalMeta` dates and version updated; SMS terms still carrier-compliant
- [ ] New image uploaded to ImageKit and registered in `lib/assets.ts`
